provenance.notes: Fictional message and documentation example IDs. Slack documents ok/channel/ts, timestamp-inclusive history lookup, mutable message representations, and the three entity equivalents & < >. This models an entity-escaped echo; it does not establish that Slack automatically transformed the reported incident. Backticks, Unicode arrows and newlines are retained, not invented as extra escape rules.
